method: Read-only inspection of existing trial evidence and pinned source. No additional HTTP requests, workload, build, or source/fixture edits.

observed.server_log_text:
listening on 127.0.0.1:24000 (poller)
DIAG writes/s 1927 commits/s 210 worst commit 15.0 ms · checkpoints 102 (worst 107 ms) · WAL log 0 ckpt 0 · held max 64
observed.limits: wrk retained only an aggregate non-2xx/non-3xx count. No individual response status, response body, or per-route error breakdown is available.

source_evidence.fact: Separate writer and read connections; comments explicitly describe the read connection snapshot trailing commits.
REFRESH_MS is 20; refreshRead ends/restarts the read transaction.
Deferred commit marks pending but does not immediately set wBusy; inline path refreshes reads synchronously.
POST /posts inserts on db and calls deferred commit before producing its response.
GET /feed selects feedW when wBusy=false; GET /posts/{id} selects postR when wBusy=true and returns HTTP 404 when that connection sees no row.
Write responses are held for commit; unrelated read responses may be sent immediately.
A landed commit marks rStale; refresh occurs at the 20 ms threshold, while wBusy selects the reader during in-flight commits.
Requests in a poller batch are handled before pending writes are handed to the commit thread at batch end.
The mixed client reuses IDs extracted from compact GET /feed responses for later GET /posts/{id} and POST /posts/{id}/like requests.
Thrown handler exceptions produce logged errors and HTTP 500 responses; the retained log contains no such error output.

inference.confidence: Strong source-supported hypothesis; exact emitted status remains unobserved.
inference.mechanism: A /feed response from the writer connection can expose IDs newer than rdb. This includes newly committed rows and, within the same poller batch, potentially uncommitted inserted rows. A subsequent request for one of those IDs may switch to rdb during an in-flight commit; rdb retains an older read transaction until refreshRead, so postR finds no row and returns 404. The live-ID mixed workload repeatedly exercises this inconsistency.
inference.scope: Does not assert that all 20,215 observed error responses were 404, or that every error came from this route.

classification_implication: Retain measured_with_errors and exclude from clean ranking unless later retained evidence contradicts the observed aggregate errors.
